tasks.AnalyzeResults: Analyze the test results to determine if the function works as expected, considering edge cases such as duplicates, negative, zero, and positive integers, and lists with fewer than three elements.
tasks.DefineTestCases: Create test cases for the function based on provided examples and additional constraints.
tasks.ImplementTests: Write tests using an appropriate testing framework to cover all defined test cases.
tasks.RunTests: Execute the written tests and collect results.
